results.description: Original full mixed-peer suite: 3 runner, 4 examples, 8 clients, 5 services pass; 21 generated service tests fail with missing native connect information.
One failing all-shape generated-service test rerun serially reproduces failure, excluding parallel scheduling as the explanation.
Native accepts absent unary and server-streaming requests as default; tonic rejects INTERNAL. Framed empty and both empty-input streaming controls match.
Native accepts absent OK unary/client-streaming response as default; tonic rejects INTERNAL. Valid empty and error-precedence controls match.

fixes.change: Preserve absent frame as None; require a request or successful response for single-message sides; preserve non-OK trailer precedence and zero-input streaming.
Materialize native TCP/TLS connect information before forwarding the opaque HTTP request into tonic-generated service layers. Native typed-request fast path stays lazy.

remaining_functional_gaps.source: pbrs-grpc/src/client/channel.rs Endpoint and channel constructors; no user executor hook
remaining_functional_gaps.effect: Cannot direct native connection-driver tasks to a supplied executor as tonic permits.
Native enabled keepalive sends PINGs while idle; there is no independent idle-off policy.
Native TCP_NODELAY is always enabled, with no policy to allow Nagle.
HTTP/1.1 browser capability exists through Tower/Hyper recipe; it is not a native listener setting.
